SMB-INTEROP-VECTOR CONFIRMED security (s.root_cause: the first '<!DOCTYPE' substring anywhere in the text decided allow_dtd; a commented decoy returned ExternalIdOnly, so allow_dtd=true and roxmltree expanded the real internal subset
SMB-INTEROP-VECTOR CONFIRMED security (s.fix: scan_prolog walks the prolog like roxmltree's grammar (XML declaration, PIs, comments, whitespace, then the single DOCTYPE); allow_dtd is never true; internal subset or unterminated DOCTYPE -> EntityDenied; an external-id-only DOCTYPE is blanked with spaces before parsing (legacy Illustrator files still import, reported doctype_external_id_ignored); DOCTYPE mentions in comments, PIs and CDATA are inert (this also removes the false refusal such a mention used to cause)
SMB-INTEROP-VECTOR CONFIRMED security (s.regression_test: tests/vector_edit_roundtrip.rs::doctype_decoy_cannot_enable_entity_expansion (3 decoy prologs + internal-subset entity whose text is markup -> EntityDenied; benign mentions import; decoy before a legacy DOCTYPE imports with the loss code; undeclared entity ref -> MalformedXml). SMB-INTEROP-VECTOR CONFIRMED security (s.note: roxmltree internal-entity amplification bounds (UNVERIFIED in the review) are moot: DTD processing is never enabled

notes.api_change_slice2: StyleProposal.fill/stroke replaced by items: Vec<AppearanceItem> (fills()/strokes() helpers); StrokePaint removed; Limits gains max_decompressed_bytes; Provenance gains decoded_len; VectorError gains Gzip(&str); the slice-1 paint-server test now uses a pattern as the unsupported server because gradients are supported; FOLIO MIGRATION (30c3e64): VectorProposal.styles/StyleProposal and crate-local Paint, Rgba, StrokeStyle, StrokeAppearance, AppearanceItem, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, GradientStop, SpreadMethod, StrokeCap, StrokeJoin removed; VectorProposal gains design (StudioDesignRecords) and gradient_provenance, plus VectorProposal::layer_style()/gradient_units(), layer_style(design, layer_id), LAYER_STYLE_REF; VectorPath.fill_style_id removed (layer to style goes through design.nodes[].style_refs.fill_style_id, one style per layer); export_svg/export_svg_with_loss take &StudioDesignRecords instead of &[StyleProposal]; Limits.max_nodes also caps design records (16 per node)
notes.folio_need: RESOLVED by Folio 0e6142c: paint, gradient, stroke and appearance rows live in StudioPaintStyle/StudioNodeDesign and this crate now uses them. Still not in Folio (typed losses here): pattern, image, CMYK, spot, gray, lab paints, gradient kinds angular/diamond/freeform/mesh, per-side stroke weights, arrowheads, gradient application mode on strokes, effect rows. Folio carries dash_offset and gradient spread without a spec field (STU-VEC-145 states no dash phase); SVG has no counterpart for gradient midpoints (STU-VEC-136), perceptual interpolation or dither, and none for per-row opacity/blend/visibility on a multi-row stack (reported on export)
notes.gradient_model: StudioGradient keeps geometry in gradient space plus one affine to document points; objectBoundingBox is converted exactly with the tight bbox of the element geometry (curve extrema), so SVG gradientUnits survives only as provenance (VectorProposal.gradient_provenance / gradient_units(style_id, row)); export always writes userSpaceOnUse with the full matrix
notes.nib_dependency: nib OwnedPath (SMB-NIB-ENG-1) landed; used via OwnedPath::from_anchors in VectorPath::to_geometry
notes.folio_note: folio StudioLayer gained text_frame (other lane); this crate sets text_frame: None
design_choices: no allow_external field on ImportPolicy: no code path fetches anything, so a switch that can only be false would mislead
element opacity lives only in Folio LayerAppearance; fill and stroke opacity are folded into paint alpha (gradient stops included)
compound SVG path = several VectorPath sharing layer_id (one Payload::Vector layer lists all ids); UNVERIFIED whether that carries compound fill-rule hole semantics
Winding::None encodes fill none (nib: no fill); the fill-rule of an unfilled path is not kept
closing curve whose end equals the first anchor is merged into the first anchor's incoming handle (Illustrator storage)
a legacy DOCTYPE with external id only is accepted and reported ExternalDenied doctype_external_id_ignored; roxmltree never resolves it
SVGZ: one gzip member only; the decompressed payload is never unwrapped again; input cap max_bytes applies to the compressed bytes

paint style names svg/<n> and publish_key svg-import/<n> are import-local ordinals (ids are synthetic and rewritten on adoption, STU-IO-190); colours are opaque 0..1 RGB with the null (document working space) profile, never an invented SCPF

one PAINT style per vector layer holds the whole stack and is named by fill_style_id (stroke-only stacks included); other style_refs keys on a vector layer are reported on export (style_ref_not_exported)
export treats Folio row opacity < 100 on a gradient as fill-opacity/stroke-opacity (SVG multiplies it with stop-opacity); import never produces it (gradient alpha is folded into the stops)
